fields.description: NOTE: product/goods cost is deliberately NOT a cost component here. Per critique M8 the supplier goods value (and CIF freight already embedded in the supplier PI) is EXCLUDED from the landed-cost build to avoid double capitalization — it is carried on the Purchase Receipt / Purchase Invoice, not re-added as a Landed Cost Voucher line.
